# AGENTS.md — 12-finance-app

Instructions for AI coding agents working in this folder.

## Context
- Template: **Tally**, personal finance app, style "Accountant's ledger".
- Stack: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Recharts, Vite. Do not add dependencies unless the user asks.
- The design contract is in `DESIGN.md`. Read it before changing anything visual.

## Files
- `src/content.js` — envelopes, ledger entries, all copy (EN + RU)
- `src/App.jsx` — page sections and the calculator
- `src/index.css` — tokens in Tailwind `@theme` + ledger, stamp, graph-paper utilities

## How to run
- `npm install`
- `npm run dev`
- `npm run build   # ./dist`

## Rules
- Content changes go to the content file, not into markup or components.
- Every user-facing string exists in **en** and **ru**. English is the default; `?lang=ru` and the language button switch it.
- Colors, fonts, radii and spacing are tokens. Change tokens, not individual elements.
- Keep the signature block: Savings calculator that writes each year into ledger rows and plots the curve like pen on graph paper.
- Keep accessibility: semantic headings, visible focus, alt text, `prefers-reduced-motion` support, body text contrast ≥ 4.5:1.
- Keep it static: no backend, no booking or payment flows.
- Red means money going out or a warning — nothing else.
- Numbers are always monospace and right-aligned in ruled columns.
- Charts are thin pen lines on graph paper: no gradients, no area fills.
- Sliders look like rulers; envelopes look like paper.
- Never give investment advice in copy; keep the disclaimer.

## Done means
- The page builds/opens without console errors.
- Both languages render with no missing strings.
- Layout works from 360 px to 1920 px wide.
